review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its main concepts against the rest of the Lie library: `LinearWeights`, `Weight.toLinear` and `Weight.ker`, and the `shiftedGenWeightSpace` type synonym with its `LieRingModule` and `LieModule` instances. I found no independent Mathlib declaration that represents the same concept. I grepped for `shiftedGenWeightSpace`, `Weight.ker` and `LinearWeights`, and they are used only in this file, Killing.lean and TraceForm.lean. A grep over the Lie directory for twisted or shifted module structures found only unrelated constructions: TensorProduct, DirectSum, Derivation, TrivialLieModule and SemiDirect. `Weight.toLinear` is a named bundling of a weight as a linear map, with its coercion and `LinearMapClass` instance, so it is not a competing concept. `Weight.ker` is a small abbreviation for `LinearMap.ker`, which is an intentional specialisation. I did not look for a generic Lie-module twist outside `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie`, so I have some residual uncertainty there.
